messages.author: 6c27402f264740f4
messages.subject: Gamma dist error
parts:
So in my quest to use inla i am running into another error that i am not sure about. What might be causing this. All the data seems to be fine to use in this model and this is similar to other inla models iv used the only difference is the dependent variable. The dependent variable in this case "backers_count" seems to follow the assumptions. Also just to check i ran this in lognormal to try an i get a similar error.

Any help would be appreciated 

Error gamma:
*** ERROR ***  INLA.Data1: Gamma data[5] (y) = 0 or weight 1 is void

Error log normal:
*** ERROR *** INLA.Data1: LogNormal y[5] = 0 is < 0


kick2 <- backers_count ~ goal + Twords + City_Pop + Length_of_kick +
  Days_spent_making_campign  + Categories + County + 
  f(state_codes, model = "bym", graph = USA.adj, diagonal = 1e-4) +
  f(year, model = "rw2", diagonal = 1e-4) +
  f(year1, model = "iid") +
  f(state_codes1, model = "besag" , graph = USA.adj, diagonal = 1e-4,
    group = year2, 
    control.group = list(model = "rw2"))

mod.climbUSD1 <- inla(kick2, family = "gamma", data = t23,
                     control.predictor = list(compute = TRUE),
                     control.compute = list(dic = TRUE, cpo = TRUE),
                     control.inla = list(cmin = 0),
                     verbose = TRUE)
